authoring_oracle.implementation: onnxruntime 1.23.2 CPUExecutionProvider, single threaded with default graph optimization, original faster-whisper vad.py consumers. Only asset-path import selection is changed in the original Python consumer oracle; all neural, threshold, duration, chunk and mapping algorithms remain original.
authoring_oracle.runtime_and_public_tests: No NumPy, ONNX runtime, native library, download, process or external program is required.

interfaces: Audio/probabilities are Python sequences and collected audio uses array(f); upstream NumPy object types are not impersonated.

model.architecture: 256-sample STFT learned Fourier basis, magnitude, four Conv1d/ReLU layers, LSTM128, Conv1d/Sigmoid. Original input [sequence,576], h/c [1,1,128].
model.format: ONNX IR8/opset18, pytorch2.8.0 producer; original embedded float32 tensor data retained unchanged.
model.input: 16 kHz float audio; 512-sample windows and previous64 context. The strict reader rejects all other model hashes; no general graph evaluation or executable code loading.

preserved_behavior: All original VadOptions and threshold/negative-threshold hysteresis
Original minimum speech/silence, maximum duration split and neighboring padding behavior
Unconditional final zero padding, including an extra512 window for aligned or empty input
Original model context view clears the final window tail64 samples; equivalent input values are used without mutating the caller sequence
h/c reset at each whole-audio call and continue through every window, without resetting at encoder batch boundaries
Original collect_chunks audio/metadata behavior and SpeechTimestampsMap boundary rounding
scope: Qualified standard-library inference for the exact faster-whisper 1.2.1 Silero VAD v6 ONNX asset, including recurrent whole-audio state, speech timestamps, chunks and timestamp restoration. This is not a general ONNX runtime or a Whisper speech decoder.

verified.discrete_segments_chunks_and_timestamp_r: Exact matches to original faster-whisper consumers, including real model outputs.
verified.floating_point_scope: Neural float32 arithmetic is compared within explicit tolerance, not claimed bit-exact across native CPU kernels.

large_encoder_batch_boundary.public_state_tolerance: abs5e-5 + relative1e-6 for the native carried-state boundary; existing short-state tolerance remains abs5e-5.
